title: Join CIReN
intro: Apply to join the Campus Innovation & Research Network, or to host a chapter on your campus. We review applications on a rolling basis and reply by email.
_comment_action: POST endpoint: the Google Apps Script web app that saves entries to the leaders’ workspace spreadsheet and emails alerts (integrations/forms-to-sheets.gs; setup in README, “Form submissions”). Keep the ?form= value: it picks the tab.
_comment_showWhen: A field with showWhen only appears when the named field holds one of the listed values. While hidden it is also disabled, so it is neither validated nor submitted - a hidden field that is still required blocks submission with no visible error.

pattern.message: Students must apply with a university email ending in .edu, .edu.<country> (e.g. .edu.gh) or .ac.<country>. Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook and other personal addresses are not accepted.
pattern.hint: Use your student email, e.g. name@st.ug.edu.gh or name@school.edu. Personal addresses such as Gmail are not accepted for students.

fields.name: motivation
fields.label: Why do you want to join CIReN?
fields.placeholder: What draws you to the network, and what would you hope to get out of it?

fields.name: tech_journey
fields.label: Tell us about your tech/research journey so far
fields.placeholder: Where you started, what you have built or researched, and where you stand right now.

_comment_demoMode: DEMO ONLY. With no `action` set, submitting shows a success confirmation WITHOUT sending anything anywhere. Set `action` to a real endpoint and demoMode to false before launch, or applicants will believe they applied.
_comment_validation: pattern: the value must match `regex` (case-insensitive), only while `when` holds. minWords/maxWords: word limits with a live counter. Both are checked in the browser before sending.

success.title: Application received!
success.message: Thank you, {name}. We review applications on a rolling basis and will reply to {email}.
